summary.text: Marion Rarick is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 29B who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was formerly known as Marion O'Neill.

paragraphs.text: Marion Rarick assumed office in the Minnesota House on January 8, 2013, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy, Higher Education Finance and Policy, Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, and Ways and Means committees, and she co-chairs the Higher Education Finance and Policy Committee.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
